nodes.description: Address of the contract CEO/developer receiving commissions; owner of all planets at creation.
Array of Planet structs holding name, ownerAddress, curPrice and curResources.
Mapping tracking how many planets each address owns; used as ownership gate in StealResources.
Mapping of attack points purchased per address.
Mapping of defense points purchased per address.
Fixed price of an attack purchase (10000000000000000 wei).
Fixed price of a defense purchase (10000000000000000 wei).
Incrementing nonce mixed into keccak256 randomness for resource stealing.
Guard flag intended to prevent re-initialization of planets.
Payable function letting a player buy a planet, paying 95% to the previous owner and 5% to the CEO, then re-pricing the planet.
Payable function that sells attack points for the fixed attackCost, forwarding ETH to the CEO.
Payable function that sells defense points for the fixed defenseCost, forwarding ETH to the CEO.
Attempts to steal a pseudo-random percentage of another planet's resources based on attack vs defense counts.
View helper returning planet, attack and defense counts of a user.
View helper returning a planet's fields plus its owner's attack and defense counts.
CEO-only function pushing a new Planet into the planets array.
CEO-only bootstrap function that creates the initial set of planets once.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, payments and authorization checks.
Block timestamp (now) used as entropy for the steal randomness.
External ETH transfer to the previous planet owner executed before ownership/state is updated (reentrancy).
External ETH transfer of the 5% commission to ceoAddress.
External ETH transfer of msg.value to ceoAddress in purchaseAttack after the require check.
External ETH transfer of msg.value to ceoAddress in purchaseDefense after the require check.
External ETH transfer of resourcesStealable to msg.sender performed before curResources is decremented (reentrancy).
Unsigned subtraction of 1 from addressPlanetsCount of the previous owner, may underflow.
Unsigned subtraction of resourcesStealable from curResources, may underflow if accounting is inconsistent.
Pseudo-randomness derived from keccak256(now, msg.sender, randNonce), predictable/miner-influenceable.
Planet index supplied by the buyer.
Planet index supplied by the attacker.
Address queried in getUserDetails.
Planet index queried in getPlanet.
Name for the newly created planet.
Initial price for the newly created planet.
Local holding the computed 5% commission ((msg.value/10)/2).
Local holding the 95% payout owed to the previous planet owner.
Local random value in [0,48] derived from keccak256 entropy.
Local amount of resources computed to be stolen (50-99% of curResources).
Storage pointer to the requested Planet struct in getPlanet.
Local index of the newly pushed planet in createPlanet.

edges.reason: Buyer-supplied planet id selects the Planet entry whose price and owner are used.
msg.sender becomes the new owner and its planet counter is incremented.
planets array is read and mutated (owner, price, resources).
addressPlanetsCount is read for the seller and updated for the buyer.
purchasePlanet invokes an external ETH transfer to the previous owner before updating ownership state.
The 95% commission amount is the value sent in the external transfer.
purchasePlanet performs a second external ETH transfer to ceoAddress while state is still inconsistent.
Computed 5% commission is the amount transferred to the CEO.
Owner commission is derived from the 5% commission value.
ceoAddress is the recipient of the 5% commission transfer.
purchasePlanet decreases the previous owner's planet counter by one.
addressPlanetsCount value is decremented, risking unsigned underflow.
attackCost is compared with msg.value in the require check.
addressAttackCount of msg.sender is incremented.
msg.sender keys the attack counter update.
purchaseAttack forwards the full payment to ceoAddress.
defenseCost is compared with msg.value in the require check.
addressDefenseCount of msg.sender is incremented.
msg.sender keys the defense counter update.
purchaseDefense forwards the full payment to ceoAddress.
Attacker-supplied planet id selects the victim planet.
msg.sender provides attack count, ownership proof and is the transfer recipient.
Ownership of at least one planet is required via addressPlanetsCount[msg.sender].
planets entry supplies owner, resources and the owner's defense lookup key.
Victim owner's defense count gates whether resources can be stolen.
Attacker's attack count gates whether the steal branch executes.
block.timestamp (now) is consumed as entropy for the steal calculation, creating timestamp dependency.
block.timestamp feeds the keccak256 randomness source.
msg.sender is hashed into the pseudo-random value.
randNonce is hashed into the pseudo-random value and incremented each call.
StealResources computes predictable randomness inside the attack branch.
The keccak256 hash modulo 49 produces the random local.
The random percentage is used to compute resourcesStealable from curResources.
StealResources sends ETH to msg.sender before updating the victim planet's resources.
The computed steal amount is the value of the outbound external transfer.
StealResources subtracts the stolen amount from the victim's curResources.
curResources of the planet is the state variable decreased, risking underflow.
resourcesStealable is subtracted from curResources.
Queried address parameter used to index the three mappings.
addressPlanetsCount is read for the queried user.
addressAttackCount is read for the queried user.
addressDefenseCount is read for the queried user.
Planet id parameter indexes into the planets array.
planets array is read to fill the returned struct fields.
getPlanet binds a storage pointer to the requested planet.
Owner attack count is read for the returned planet.
Owner defense count is read for the returned planet.
Planet name argument is stored in the new Planet struct.
Planet price argument becomes the initial curPrice.
ceoAddress becomes the initial owner of a newly created planet.
onlyCeo modifier compares msg.sender with ceoAddress before execution.
createPlanet pushes a new entry into the planets array.
The push return value minus one is assigned to the planetId local.
planetsAreInitiated flag is required to be false before bootstrapping planets.
onlyCeo modifier restricts InitiatePlanets to ceoAddress via msg.sender.
InitiatePlanets repeatedly calls createPlanet to seed the game.

normalization_plan.reason: The buyer-supplied planet index is only meaningful inside purchasePlanet's pricing and ownership logic.
The attacker-supplied planet index only selects the victim inside StealResources.
The queried address parameter exists solely to index mappings in getUserDetails.
The planet id parameter is only used to load the planet struct in getPlanet.
The name argument is consumed immediately when building the Planet struct in createPlanet.
The price argument is consumed immediately as the initial curPrice in createPlanet.
This local is computed only to be sent in the 5% external transfer to ceoAddress.
This local is computed only to be sent in the 95% external transfer to the previous owner.
This local is the direct output of the weak keccak256(now, msg.sender, randNonce) randomness computation.
This local is computed only to be sent out to msg.sender and subtracted from curResources.
The storage pointer aliases planets[_planetId] and is only used within getPlanet.
The pushed index local is only used within createPlanet.
